title: SocialFi Inspector
tagline: SocialFi Inspector Flow: Analyze your social activity, segment into groups, and discover your potential with AI insights. Earn $DEGEN by engaging with the community. Powered by Farcaster, OpenRank, Blockscout, and Dune Analytics.
description: SocialFi Inspector Flow is a platform designed to analyze users' social activities and provide insights into their potential within the social finance ecosystem. By leveraging AI and blockchain technologies, the platform segments users into groups based on their activity and identifies top performers who have earned the most $DEGEN tokens. Users can log in using their Farcaster account, and the system retrieves their social activity data using OpenRank APIs. The AI then analyzes this data to generate personalized insights and suggestions, helping users maximize their engagement and earnings.
how_its_made:
SocialFi Inspector Flow is built using a combination of modern web technologies and blockchain integrations. The front end is developed with React, providing a responsive and interactive user interface. For authentication, we use Warpcast.com to allow users to log in with their Farcaster accounts. The backend is powered by Node.js and Express, handling API requests and data processing.

We utilize OpenRank APIs to fetch user social activity data, which is then analyzed by our AI system. The AI segments users into groups and identifies top performers using data from Blockscout and Dune Analytics. The insights generated by the AI are presented to users in a clear and actionable format.

Our use of partner technologies like Farcaster, OpenRank, Blockscout, and Dune Analytics has been crucial in providing accurate and comprehensive data for analysis. Additionally, we implemented several optimizations and caching mechanisms to ensure the platform runs smoothly and efficiently, even with large volumes of data.
